test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of five numbers is 40. If one number is removed, then the average becomes 36. What is the removed number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Old average of 5 numbers = 40

New average of 4 numbers = 36

Decrease in average = 40 − 36 = 4

Removed number = Old Average + (New Count × Decrease in Average)

Removed number = 40 + (4 × 4) = 40 + 16 = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 5 numbers = 40

Average of 4 numbers = 36

**Formula:**

Sum = Average × Count

Removed Number = (Sum of 5 numbers) − (Sum of 4 numbers)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61ab456d57e61c07997d229d88c548ee778f1496d957a6f3d07ea29b5c6bfff8.png] 

⇒ Sum₅ = 5 × 40 = 200

⇒ Sum₄ = 4 × 36 = 144

⇒ Removed number = 200 − 144

⇒ Removed number = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Basic Formula

Average = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Excluded Value Rule

When one value is excluded: Excluded Value = (Original Count × Original Average) − (New Count × New Average).

Average Change Property

If every observation in a set is increased or decreased by a constant value 'k', then the average also increases or decreases by 'k'.
